material.text: Criterion B1 reads: the setup questions are drawn in a plain Terminal, each with its options numbered and their meanings beneath them.

options.label: Keep it
options.meaning: B1 stands as written. The build is held to it.

options.label: Reword it
options.meaning: You give the new wording next. The build waits for it.

later.label: Decide later
later.meaning: B1 stays open. It is asked again at the next review.

questions.change_later: edit the criterion in the intent
